functions.tag: {title:"Experiment Logs - Divine Body",author:"Unknown",generation:3,pages:['[{"text":"Entry 1\\n","italic":true,"underlined":true},{"text":"It seems I have come into possession of a great power.\\nThis Body generates as a defense mechanism; a magical and biological machine of brute and brawn.\\nIt is my understanding that this Body generates when the Heavens deem it necessary for my survival.","italic":true,"underlined":false}]','[{"text":"Entry 2\\n","italic":true,"underlined":true},{"text":"I have empirically confirmed limitations to my Gift. There exists a maximum exertion; when I begin to perceive red tendrils of flesh and blood, I am overexerting myself.\\nFor every new Body, my exertion limit decreases by a constant percentage until I slumber or pause.","italic":true,"underlined":false}]']}

{title:"Experiment Logs - Steam",author:"Unknown",generation:3,pages:['[{"text":"Entry 1\\n","italic":true,"underlined":true},{"text":"I was mortally wounded, certain of my death. By the Heavens do I not know how I survived. I observed Steam; my flesh was born anew.\\nI attempt to keep my journals scientific, however this miracle remains, at present, nothing short of divine.","italic":true,"underlined":false}]',[{"text":"Entry 2\\n","italic":true,"underlined":true},{"text":"This Steam may be the cause of my Power, or at minimum the vessel by which it travels. I measure this very same Steam when my Divine Body generates.\\nI have found that my emission of Steam arouses... great suspicion among my neighbors. I must endeavor to avoid public injury.","italic":true,"underlined":false}]',[{"text":"Entry 3\\n","italic":true,"underlined":true},{"text":"Aha! After a great deal of time and practice, I have discovered ways to both conceal and empower this Steam. I may bid it away, leaving my wounds vulnerable; I may excite its ability, recovering entire limbs in mere seconds.","italic":true,"underlined":false}]']}

{title:"Experiment Logs - Nape",author:"Unknown",generation:3,pages:['[{"text":"Entry 1\\n","italic":true,"underlined":true},{"text":"My Divine Body seldom disappoints in combat, and yet, I have empirically divined one single point of weakness: the Nape of its neck. If a sufficient blow manages to slash at my Nape, I am thrown from the Body with extreme ill.\\nI find it useful to employ my Body's hand to protect this disadvantageous flaw.","italic":true,"underlined":false}]']}

{title:"Experiment Logs - Energy",author:"Unknown",generation:3,pages:['[{"text":"Entry 1\\n","italic":true,"underlined":true},{"text":"I am greatly startled by the bright Energy emanating from my human form. It unsettles me; it dances on my skin and buzzes in the air. I find it to often coincide with the mystical Steam, though it seems to require a larger degree of injury to activate.","italic":true,"underlined":false}]','[{"text":"Entry 2\\n","italic":true,"underlined":true},{"text":"I believe this Energy serves as a useful indicator to me! When present, I may concentrate to begin generating a Divine Body.\\nThe Energy has indeed to appear with greater ease as well. Perhaps, I theorize, as I use this Power more, it becomes easier to activate?","italic":true,"underlined":false}]']}
